Name: AT - Crop Variety
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/8IltdgV.png[/img][size=3]﻿
Crop Variety is an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] pack which adds over 120 texture variations to the various crops and flowers of Stardew Valley.

Every crop and flower has [i]at least[/i] 3 different variations, though the differences between them can be subtle.[/size]


[img]https://imgur.com/yPR5yuE.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://imgur.com/fP5yPeU.png[/img]
[b][size=3]What if I don't like a particular variation of a crop / flower?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Individual textures from AT packs can be disabled via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿.[/size]
[/list]

[b][size=3]Will the different variations appear in my inventory (such as the recolored flowers?)[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Alternative Textures only affects the "overworld" textures, so the items you harvest will revert back to their normal sprites.[/size]
[*][size=3]This means the different variations will not take up any additional inventory space, as they will utilize the vanilla sprites.[/size]
[/list]
